package.name: ipp_baselines_search_planner
package.description: The ia-tigris informative-path-planning baselines (greedy, rect_coverage, mcts_search from ia-tigris/src/ipp_planners) as one AirStack global planner, chosen by the `planner` parameter. A ROS-free C++17 port that shares the IA-TIGRIS port's scenario, Dubins, cone footprint, single-axis gimbal, belief/rewards (matched by default, or the ia-tigris SearchMap reward) and receding horizon, so the baselines are benchmarked on the same sensor, gimbal and belief model as TIGRIS, IA-TIGRIS and MTL. It serves the mtl_msgs SearchMission interface, so the MTL follower and metrics logger fly and score it unchanged.
